_comment: StrataBI Developer / Community Edition — DATA PLANE ONLY (no ECS/ALB/VPC/ECR/Cognito). Source-available under the Shaleio Guild Community License (SGCL) v1.0. delivery=local so the tofu is cached into the customer bucket and teardown works offline. The bundle ships the infra under tofu/ and the theme assets under stratabi/themes/ so the tofu's ${path.module}/../stratabi/themes path resolves inside the bundle. required_permissions is the SIMPLE (broad service:*) form for a first-party data-plane module. Installed HQ-free (no StrataHQ entitlement).
